articles.title: NCLT approved 107 resolution plans worth Rs 11,000 crore in Q2
articles.description: The National Company Law Tribunal has set a new benchmark by approving 107 Resolution Plans in the second quarter of FY 2026–27, a remarkable rise from 60 approved plans in the corresponding quarter of the previous year. Over the first half of the financial year, a total of 185 plans were sanctioned. To date, the Tribunal has approved 1,735 Resolution Plans since its beginning until the end of September 2026.

articles.title: US stocks: Webull shares plunge 18% after report flags structural ties to China
articles.description: Webull shares fell by more than 18% following a report connecting the platform to the Chinese government. The House Select Committee on China revealed discrepancies between Webull’s marketing and its operational reality. Concerns were raised about the company’s reliance on infrastructure subject to Chinese laws. Analysts expressed uncertainty about the regulatory implications affecting the stock's performance. This scrutiny reflects growing apprehension in Washington regarding Chinese involvement in critical US sectors.

Additionally, smaller export transactions of up to ₹10 lakh may rely on self-declarations.
